comparison.objective: Seat a tilted add-on board squarely onto two rows of header pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine multi-pin alignment and even press-fitting without bending pins.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully seated, still, and released; any excessive tilt during engagement records bent-pin failure.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed compliant insertion and even pressing, not localized impact fracture or post-fracture fragment handling.
